# Deadwood Reblooms v1.1.0 — DoL 0.5.11.9 compatibility

此分支构建面向 **DoL 0.5.11.9** 及对应汉化，与 0.5.12.13 构建同属枯木逢春 v1.1.0。请按游戏版本选择主包，勿同时加载两份。

- 移除首次模块选择弹窗，改由框架管理模块开关。
- 扩充罗宾的摊位与峭壁街店铺，加入新品、鲜花、爆米花、气球代售与正式店员。
- 调整悉尼科学课换班门槛，补充惠特尼营救后续、住宅日程、金融事件与峭壁街健身房。
- 适配旧版鱼饵商店、射精宏、贝利办公室及每周收租代码的补丁位置。

先安装[秋枫白桦框架 5.1.1 或更新版本](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/SCML-DOL-maplebirchFramework)，再加载 `deadwood-reblooms-0.5.11.9-v1.1.0.modpack`。音频包可选。发布文件均为加密 `.modpack`。

---

**English:** This build targets **DoL 0.5.11.9** and its matching Chinese localization. Choose the main package for your game version and do not load both builds. Version 1.1.0 removes the first-load module selector, expands Robin's stalls and shop, adjusts Sydney's science transfer, and adds follow-up scenes, housing and finance refinements, and the Cliff Street gym. Older game patch anchors are adapted for this build. Install [Maplebirch Framework 5.1.1 or newer](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/SCML-DOL-maplebirchFramework) first. The audio pack is optional. Only encrypted `.modpack` files are published.
